name: Browser agent
description: A desktop computer with a visible browser; a person can take over the screen.

agent.description: Works in a browser on a desktop computer.
agent.instructions: Use the browser to complete the task. Leave every file you produce in /home/user/outbox.

name: Shell/report agent
description: No browser. Works in files and leaves its report in the outbox.

agent.description: Writes files and a report. Uses no browser.
agent.instructions: Do the task in the workspace with shell commands and files. Leave the report and every deliverable in /home/user/outbox, then reply with the list of files.

name: Sign-in agent
description: A browser agent that asks a person to sign in or enter codes through take-over.

agent.description: Signs in to a site. Never types a credential or a code itself.
agent.instructions: Use the browser to sign in where the task says. When a sign-in step needs a password, a code or a choice only a person can make, request a take-over and wait. If you cannot finish a step, say why and stop.
